setup.title: Set up {{property}}
setup.intro: Work through the checklist. Bookings open once every required step is done and you go live.
setup.introLive: This property is live. You can still change its details here.

laterText.tax: Here you will set VAT and the state consumption tax for this property.
laterText.room-types: Here you will add room types, or import them from Excel.
laterText.rooms: Here you will add rooms and their numbers, or import them from Excel.
laterText.rates: Here you will set your rate plans and prices.

setup.paymentIntro: Which payments do you take at the desk?
setup.paymentOnline: Online card payments and bank virtual accounts are added when the payment provider is connected.
setup.staffText: Invite your managers and staff now, or later from Users and roles. This step is optional.
setup.goLiveReady: Everything required is done. Going live opens the property for bookings.

setup.registrationIntro: What the front desk must collect when a guest checks in. Only these are kept; ID details are encrypted.
